chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Abdul Kareem ibn Amr al-Khasha'i, from Ibn Abi Yafour, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Indeed, Ali (peace be upon him) married Fatima (peace be upon her) upon a threadbare garment, a shield, and a bed which was from the skin of a ram.'

key_terms.دِرْعٍ: A shield or coat of armor

ai.seo_question: What was the dowry of Imam Ali and Fatima?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Kafi underscores the asceticism (zuhd) of the Ahl al-Bayt, illustrating that the Prophet’s daughter married the Commander of the Faithful with minimal material wealth, consisting of a worn garment, a shield, and a ram-skin bed. This event is frequently cited by Shia scholars as a model for modest marriage practices and a critique of worldly extravagance, emphasizing spiritual compatibility over financial status.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Abdul Kareem Bin Amro and Al Khash’amy, from Ibn Abu Yafour who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying that Ali<sup>asws</sup> married Fatima<sup>asws</sup> upon a (dower of) a threadbare garment, and a shield, and a bed which was from the skin of a ram’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr from ‘Abd al-Karim ibn ‘Amr al-Khath’amiy from ibn abu Ya’fur who has said the following: “I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying that Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, married Fatimah, ‘Alayha al-Salam, for a mahr (dower) from the price of a single gown, a shield and a bed which was made of the hide of a ram.’”
